## Public disclosure checklist

- [ ] Content is factual and based on approved public information.
- [ ] No source code, proprietary schemas, private architecture, credentials, or internal datasets.
- [ ] No unverified customer, compliance, benchmark, or deployment claims.
- [ ] Images and media use approved official assets and safe data.
- [ ] Links, spelling, and Mermaid diagrams were reviewed.
- [ ] Human owner approved this exact public revision.
